workflow.logging_policy: Snapshot-only: keep docs/project-state.json <= 8000 bytes, task summaries <= 320 chars, and <= 6 evidence items (<= 240 chars each). Never append historical daily benchmark logs.

current_capabilities.geometry_and_vector: Analytical curves/arcs, adaptive flattening, cubic/quadratic intersections, dynamic offset/contour, OSnap & inference engine, Pen/Line/Polyline/Quick Shapes, Node editing, Contour and Dimension controllers.
current_capabilities.document_and_color: Immutable snapshots, single-writer transactions, Undo/Redo, RGB/CMYK/Spot + Linear/Radial Gradient paint (ADR 0012), appearance effect graph (Gaussian Blur, Drop Shadow, Blend Mode, Opacity), native v2 lossless storage.
current_capabilities.rendering: CPU SoftwareRasterizer in premultiplied linear-sRGB with SSE2/AVX Gaussian Blur dispatch, Drop Shadow, Blend operators, and linear/radial gradient sampling.
current_capabilities.desktop_shell: Win32/GDI native shell with Toolbox flyouts, Contextual Property Bar, Object/Style/Align Inspector, Quick Shape pick & SketchUp-style dimension input, and embedded MCP Streamable HTTP endpoint.
current_capabilities.automation_ecosystem: Shared typed AutomationService, in-process MCP HTTP endpoint, stdio MCP sidecar (pikdraw-mcp-server), and Windows COM IDispatch local server (pikdraw-com-server).

known_limitations: CPU SoftwareRasterizer only (no GPU Direct2D/D3D/Skia backend yet); GroupObject and ImageObject rendering in SoftwareRasterizer are not yet wired.

Full-resolution linear-sRGB float Gaussian Blur on older 2-core CPUs (e.g. i7-3537U) is memory/CPU bound (~50 ms for 640x480); interactive dragging uses draft preview, and further speedup requires pyramid/downsampled blur or GPU.
NodeToolController (11), ContourToolController (12), and DimensionToolController need dedicated non-overlapping Tool IDs and Toolbox/Menu entry points in NativeWindow.
Desktop UI layout uses fixed pixel metrics and needs Per-Monitor V2 DPI scaling, Status Bar vertical text centering, and Style Inspector scroll clip rect.
